record.context_brief: optimal lower bounds for polynomial recurrence
record.original_question: Suppose p1, ..., pℓ ∈ Z[t] are rationally independent and have zero constant term. For every measurable set A and every ε > 0, must there exist n ∈ N such that µ(A ∩ T1^{p1(n)} A ∩ ... ∩ Tℓ^{pℓ(n)} A) ≥ µ(A)^{ℓ+1} - ε?

evidence.quote: Problem 17. Suppose that the polynomials p1, . . . , pℓ ∈ Z[t] are rationally independent and have zero constant term. Show that for every A ∈ X and every ε > 0, there exists n ∈ N such that µ(A ∩ T1^p1(n) A ∩ · · · ∩ Tℓ^pℓ(n) A) ≥ µ(A)^ℓ+1 − ε.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(X,\mathcal{B},\mu,T_1,\dots,T_\ell)$ be a probability space equipped with $\ell$ commuting invertible measure-preserving transformations $T_1,\dots,T_\ell$. Let $p_1,\dots,p_\ell \in \mathbb{Z}[t]$ be polynomials with zero constant term that are rationally independent (meaning that no nontrivial linear combination $\sum_{i=1}^\ell c_i p_i$ with $c_i\in\mathbb{Q}$, not all zero, is the zero polynomial; equivalently, the $p_i$ are linearly independent over $\mathbb{Q}$).

Prove or disprove: for every measurable set $A\in\mathcal{B}$ and every $\varepsilon>0$, there exists $n\in\mathbb{N}$ such that
$$\mu\bigl(A\cap T_1^{p_1(n)}A\cap T_2^{p_2(n)}A\cap\cdots\cap T_\ell^{p_\ell(n)}A\bigr)\;\ge\;\mu(A)^{\ell+1}-\varepsilon.$$
artifact.status_search_result: Optimal lower bounds of the form $\mu(A)^{\ell+1}-\varepsilon$ are known in several special cases (e.g., for a single polynomial by Frantzikinakis–Kra and for certain independent families by Frantzikinakis), and Frantzikinakis established related results for non-commuting transformations along rationally independent polynomials. However, the full conjecture for $\ell$ commuting transformations along arbitrary rationally independent integer polynomials with zero constant term does not appear to have been resolved in general.

status_evidence.title: Optimal Polynomial Recurrence
status_evidence.snippet: Optimal polynomial recurrence results for single transformations and certain polynomial families.
status_evidence.claim: Optimal lower bounds of the conjectured form are known for single-polynomial cases.

status_evidence.title: Multiple recurrence for non-commuting transformations along rationally independent polynomials
status_evidence.snippet: Frantzikinakis proves multiple recurrence results for non-commuting transformations along rationally independent polynomials with zero constant term.
status_evidence.claim: Related cases of the problem have been resolved, but not in full generality.

status_evidence.title: Ergodic Averages for Independent Polynomials and Applications
status_evidence.snippet: Frantzikinakis studied ergodic averages for rationally independent polynomials, providing partial progress toward optimal recurrence bounds.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress toward optimal multiple recurrence with rationally independent polynomials.
